cohort: The study included 17,194 minority migrant and refugee women who attended antenatal care in their first trimester at the Shoklo-Malaria Research Unit along the Thailand-Myanmar border between 2004 and 2023.
finding: Optimal gestational weight gain ranges are lower for this population with short stature compared to existing international guidelines.
